questions.question: Which of the following is the site of the Krebs cycle?
questions.explanation: The Krebs (citric acid) cycle takes place in the mitochondrial matrix; glycolysis occurs in the cytosol.

questions.question: During which phase of mitosis do sister chromatids separate and move to opposite poles?
questions.explanation: In anaphase, spindle fibers pull sister chromatids apart toward opposite poles.

questions.question: Which transport process requires energy input from the cell?
questions.explanation: The sodium-potassium pump is active transport: it hydrolyzes ATP to move ions against their concentration gradients.
